claims.claim: Final qualification independently reports completed/qualified/true. This concerns documented integrity, coverage, execution and controls, not deployment validity.
Aggregate final normalized reference agreement is 0.9975639445869278, rounded to 0.99756 in the abstract.
All final structure-aware reference top-three overlaps and repeat-pair top-three/sign agreements equal one; these are separate assessments.
Stored vectors have zero maximum coordinate range across repeats within each fixed cap/model/query.
Pure reference sign agreement is 0.9994791667, not the mixed evaluator sign metric.
Mean normalized endpoint residual is 1.27919753412707e-11, control pass rate one, failed-call fraction zero and replay error zero.
The recorded full workload takes 700.3707705293782 wall seconds, rounded to 700.37, including references, comparators, training and overhead; candidate-only latency is unavailable.
Four final dataset/model conditions are German logistic, German forest, ACS logistic and ACS forest; no additional task list or downstream study is present.
claims.scope: final protocol and readable implementation evidence, not additional measurements

claims.claim: Final seeds are 104729, 130363 and 155921; caps 64/256/1024; six repeats per cap; sixteen fixed queries and training-background rows per fitted condition.
claims.scope: final protocol and readable implementation evidence, not additional measurements

claims.claim: Final German retained splits are 300/100/100 records and twenty groups; ACS 20000/6667/6667 and ten groups. These are protocol counts, not independent explained-sample counts.
claims.scope: final protocol and readable implementation evidence, not additional measurements

claims.claim: German uses original class code 2. ACS uses 2024 PUMS, native RELSHIPP without a RELP crosswalk, the retained adult filter and PINCP>50000 target.
claims.scope: final protocol and readable implementation evidence, not additional measurements

claims.claim: German development/final content groups are disjoint. ACS uses California development and New York final data after excluding raw predictor-content overlaps.
claims.scope: final protocol and readable implementation evidence, not additional measurements

claims.claim: Training-fitted ordinal vocabularies use unseen code -1; numeric medians and standardization are training fitted; queries/background use fixed ordering.
claims.scope: final protocol and readable implementation evidence, not additional measurements

claims.claim: Logistic regression uses lbfgs, max_iter 500 and tolerance 1e-7. Forests use sixty-four trees, depth six and n_jobs one.
claims.scope: final protocol and readable implementation evidence, not additional measurements

claims.claim: ACS references enumerate ten-feature finite games; German references average two independent cap-4096 library estimates. Their half-difference is a proxy, not a calibrated interval.
claims.scope: final protocol and readable implementation evidence, not additional measurements

claims.claim: Stored 95-percent intervals use 1000 bootstrap resamples of sixteen query-level means after cap/repeat averaging, conditional on one fitted model/reference.
claims.scope: final protocol and readable implementation evidence, not additional measurements

claims.claim: The normalized L1 agreement floor is 0.001; signs at magnitude at most 1e-8 are zero; top-three ties follow coordinate order. Endpoint residual is capped at one.
claims.scope: final protocol and readable implementation evidence, not additional measurements

claims.claim: Library KernelExplainer uses identity link, l1_reg zero and nsamples equal to cap. Two independent split-cap calls each use floor(cap/2).
claims.scope: final protocol and readable implementation evidence, not additional measurements

claims.claim: Forest attribution uses signed leaf-game beta-integral coefficients over all trees/background rows, intersecting repeated splits and retaining float32 predictor-input semantics.
claims.scope: final protocol and readable implementation evidence, not additional measurements

claims.claim: Probability-scale logistic integration uses ceil(d/2) inclusion nodes, eight-node frequency panels, cutoff eight and at most 2048 frequency nodes; tail tolerance 1e-10 and mesh/efficiency tolerances 1e-8.
claims.scope: final protocol and readable implementation evidence, not additional measurements

claims.claim: Two consecutive mesh agreements are required. Failure for any background row rejects integration; frequency-tail control is not a rigorous discretization bound.
claims.scope: final protocol and readable implementation evidence, not additional measurements

claims.claim: Dispatch uses forest structure directly, then generic enumeration when cap covers 2^d-2 nontrivial coalitions before logistic integration; branch counts are unrecorded.
claims.scope: final protocol and readable implementation evidence, not additional measurements

claims.claim: The sampled fallback combines independent complete paths and importance-corrected constrained regression. Alpha 0.05 separation is used only with at least two paths; acceptance coverage is absent.
claims.scope: final protocol and readable implementation evidence, not additional measurements

claims.claim: The release contains independent validation routines without retained executions. They are not additional empirical controls.
claims.scope: final protocol and readable implementation evidence, not additional measurements

claims.claim: German reference mean absolute coordinate half-differences are about 1.05e-4 logistic and 1.20e-4 forest; no error decomposition follows.
Seed-104729 query-bootstrap intervals round to [0.99618,0.99709] German logistic and [0.99292,0.99442] German forest.
Final cap-64 structure agreement is 0.9966/0.9937 German logistic/forest, versus library 0.9347/0.8806; ACS structure rounds to one versus library 0.9577/0.9636.
At cap 1024 final library means are 0.9889/0.9802 German logistic/forest and round to one for both ACS cases. This does not establish necessity of structure-aware access.
Split-cap German means at cap 64 are 0.3341/0.2995, recovering to 0.9699/0.9448 at cap 256; recorded diagnostics do not isolate a cause.
Final validation accuracy is 0.67 German logistic, 0.65--0.69 German forest, about 0.7609 ACS logistic and 0.7755--0.7773 ACS forest. Converged logistic fits use 19 and 13 iterations respectively.
Development uses seeds 1729/2718, eight queries, four repeated calls, caps 64/256; comparisons are supporting evidence, not held-out confirmation.
German cap-64 forest agreement changes from 0.858--0.870 to 0.9924--0.9929 with leaf computation; logistic from 0.946--0.951 to about 0.9963 with integration.
Custom sampled development means are nonmonotone from cap 64 to 256: ACS forest about 0.9674 to 0.9512 and German logistic 0.9488 to 0.9137; no unique cause is established.
